specification.status: Recorded before this rerun. Development extension of the frozen corrected reference; not a replacement primary or an independent confirmation.
specification.rules: Inherit the frozen primary preprocessing, policy source/variation gates, alpha grid, complete-target chronological tuning, minimum histories and full allocation settings. Apply training-only imputation, 1st/99th percentile clipping and scaling to added inputs too. Tune each asset and candidate separately using the unchanged grid. Rebuild each candidate's past-error variance and continuous portfolio from its own forecasts, including warm-up. No return-based threshold or feature search.
specification.eligibility: Require identical baseline and added-input eligibility throughout training and forecast history; abort if this dataset cannot support that comparison. Match all forecast and allocated decision dates across candidates and historical mean; never silently trim away primary dates.
specification.reproduction: Rerun the corrected baseline and require forecasts, alpha choices, allocations, error variances and costs to reproduce the frozen saved run within 1e-10 before reporting extensions.
specification.evaluation: All matched forecast dates including warm-up, then common allocated dates. Report per-asset MAE, RMSE, OOS R2 against matched historical mean and change versus corrected baseline; largest absolute forecasts and 20% flags. Then net return, daily drawdown, turnover, costs, weight-limit frequency, calendar years, episodes and rolling 12-month windows. Reuse previously recorded block-bootstrap settings without retuning. No automatic winner selection.
specification.preservation: Write separate corrected_signals_* artifacts. Preserve primary freeze/spec/code and original signal results. Revised histories and assumed availability lags remain limitations.

parent_freeze.status: Frozen corrected primary for a future separately authorized reserved test; development-selected, not independent confirmation.

settings.trade_timing: Last-trading-day decision; enter next trading-day close and exit next rebalance close. Holding month names the entry month.

settings.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of monthly net-return differences versus baseline, conditional on the fitted continuous runs
settings.statistic: mean monthly net-return difference; unadjusted percentile intervals, exploratory, no multiple-comparison correction and no model refitting

credit_shared_information.interpretation: Descriptive associations in revised histories. Past-only ANFCI projection of credit conditions is not a test of causal redundancy or asset-return predictability; the credit-versus-baseline forecast and portfolio comparisons remain necessary.

excluding_2020.description: Compound retained months from the continuous run; skip 2020 without retraining or restarting holdings. Disconnected intervals, not a tradable uninterrupted path.

unit_audit.targets: Decimal total returns over entry-close to next rebalance-close; not percent points or annualized returns.
unit_audit.covariance: Monthly decimal calendar-close returns; no annualization before BL.
unit_audit.prior_and_posterior: Monthly decimal returns with tau 0.05 and risk aversion 2.5. No cash series is supplied: views are total returns, not cash-adjusted excess returns.
unit_audit.warning_threshold: Absolute forecast above 20% per holding month is flagged for inspection only; never clipped by this diagnostic.
unit_audit.vintages: Latest revised histories with assumed lags. These diagnostics do not reconstruct real-time vintages.
